newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs end up slightly amid U.S. rate worries - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs end up slightly amid U.S. rate worries - Sept 24.

text.p: Brazilian stocks tracked late declines on Wall Street, ending only slightly higher after paring early gains on Telebras earnings and unchanged U.S. interest rates, brokers said.
"The Fed didn't raise interest rates and people were happy at first," one dealer said. "But then they grew concerned that rates will probably rise in the next few months."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of 49 most traded shares edged up 53 points to close at 65,570 points, a rise of 0.08 percent.
Telebras regularly accounts for 70percent of total trade on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
Chief blue chips loser was state miner Vale do Rio Doce, 20.24 reais.
State oil monopoly Petrobras' preferred rose 1.25 percent to close at 120.50 reais, while its common voter ended off 2.32 percent at 80.00 reais.
And federally owned power firm Eletrobras fell 1.70 percent to 289.00 reais, while state telecoms firm Telesp rose 0.73 percent to 207.00 reais.
